title: image-choice card: gallery, selection, keyboard and screen reader
goal: The owner can pick one image with mouse, touch or keyboard
acceptance: Owner idea 2026-11-26 in chat: "in future I will be able to recover a recipe or a hobo place, say it was without image, I will be able to put it in chat and tell to use that, or to find some on the web, propose (using genUI?) and save the accepted." The proposal is a bricks surface both NERV and the projects can use (nerv:F-143).

bx-image-choice-card renders a grid of candidates as a radio group (arrow keys move, Space/Enter select, visible focus), each with its alt text and a source/licence line as text, and a "none of these" choice when allowNone; emits chosen {candidateId | null}; renders payload text as text
Works in the base, plain and eva themes with tokens only; axe passes; a browser test for keyboard selection; Italian and English labels come from the consumer, with English defaults
privacy: Invented candidates and placeholder images generated in the test; no third-party image URLs in fixtures.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one card with radio-group keyboard handling and axe in three themes. Not a measurement.
